title: The 5 Oldest Universities Still Open Today, Ranked (#1 Is 1,100+ Years Old)

scenes.text: The five oldest universities still open, ranked. Number one started before England was a single kingdom.

scenes.label: Salamanca · 1134
scenes.text: Number five: the University of Salamanca in Spain. Founded around eleven thirty-four, and still teaching students today.

scenes.label: Oxford · 1096
scenes.text: Number four: Oxford. Teaching began around ten ninety-six, long before anyone had heard of a printing press.

scenes.label: Bologna · 1088
scenes.text: Number three: the University of Bologna in Italy. Ten eighty-eight, and it is still teaching students today.

scenes.label: Al-Azhar · 970
scenes.text: Number two: Al-Azhar in Cairo. Founded around nine seventy, it is more than a thousand years old.

scenes.label: Al-Qarawiyyin · 859
scenes.text: Number one: Al-Qarawiyyin in Fez, Morocco. Founded in eight fifty-nine, and recognized by Guinness as the oldest.

description:
The five oldest universities still operating today, ranked by founding year.
Al-Qarawiyyin in Fez, Morocco, opened in 859 and is recognized by UNESCO and Guinness as the oldest.
Which would you want to study at?
